tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should be a Company or Firm registered in India. (Joint ventures or Consortium are not allowed)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration (in case of Firms)
Others -- Certificate of Incorporation (in case of Company).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should have been in existence for a period of at least three years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Partnership Registration / PAN.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should be registered with Commercial Tax department and should have filed latest GST Returns.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration.
Others -- GST returns filed for the Financial Year 2025-26 and the latest completed quarter preceding the date of invitation of the bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should have PAN and should have filed Income Tax Returns for the preceding three financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of PAN.
Others -- Income Tax Returns for the last 3 financial years, i.e.,  FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25),  FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) and  FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should meet the minimum average annual turnover requirement, stated in the Section 1 - IFT, in the last three financial years, certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number. i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25), FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) and FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth Statement certified by Chartered Accountant as per format at Annexure I.
Others -- Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Statement for the last 3 financial years FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and  FY 2025-26 duly certified by CA.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should have positive Networth in the preceding three financial years, certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number. i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25), FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) and FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth Statement certified by Chartered Accountant as per format at Annexure I.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Affidavit on Rs. 100/- stamp paper notarized.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Affidavit as per format at Annexure 3.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should submit a self-declared Litigation Declaration Form on their letter head along with notarized.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Litigation Declaration Form as per format at Annexure 4.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the Tenderer is an Authorized Agent of OEM, the Tenderer should submit Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) from the manufacturer/OEM. The manufacturer/OEM can issue Manufacturer Authorization Form to more than one Authorized Agent for this IFT. The Authorized Agent/Tenderer should associate with only one manufacturer/OEM for each item in this IFT. If Tenderer submits Manufacturer Authorization Form from more than one manufacturers/OEMs for the same item of the schedule in the tender, such bids shall be summarily rejected.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Manufacturer Authorization Form as per format enclosed in Section 13.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Manufacturer/OEM performance - Manufacturer should have manufactured and supplied similar to the type, Desktops and All-In-One Computers up to at least 80% of the quantity required, in Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking, during the preceding three (3) financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Manufacturers Performance Statement as per format at Section 12.
Others -- Copy of Supply Order / Purchase Order for Authorized Suppliers performance.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Authorized Agents performance Authorized Agent should have supplied similar to the type, Desktops and All-In-One Computers up to at least 30 percent of the quantity required, in Central Government State Government Public Sector Undertaking, during the preceding three (3) financial years. Authorized Agent should submit End user certificate for the supply order purchase order submitted. Authorized Agent should be an Authorized Channel Partner of manufacturer OEM.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Authorized Agents Performance Statement as per format at Section 12/A
Others -- Copy of Supply Order / Purchase Order for Authorized Agents performance.
Others -- Copy of End user certificate / Work Completion certificate / Satisfactory Performance certificate
Others -- Authorized Channel Partner letter issued by manufacturer/OEM.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Equipment and quality control Employed by manufacturer as per proforma given in Section 14. Tenderer can also submit valid ISO9001 certification of manufacturer instead of Proforma given in Section 14.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Equipment and quality control Employed by manufacturer as per proforma given in Section 14 or ISO 9001 certificate of manufacturer.
Others -- Tender Form as per format at Section 8.
Others -- Compliance to Technical Specifications enclosed at Section 6.
Others -- Technical Literature of Quoted model.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer or OEM should have minimum 20 Service Centers in Karnataka OR Tenderer should submit a self declaration stating that the Tenderer shall open a minimum of 20 Service Centers in Karnataka within 30 days of issue of Letter of Intent for empanelment.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Proof of Service Center in Karnataka as per format at Section 15.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: OEM should submit self-declaration stating as follows: We / I hereby declare that we / I will not supply End of Life and / or refurbished equipment / items. We / I hereby declare that the items quoted by us shall be in commercial production and shall not become END OF LIFE for a period of One (1) Year from the date of empanelment and shall not become END OF SUPPORT for a period of two (2) years from the date of empanelment. We / I declare that for items quoted, the OEM shall provide service support and spares for the next two (2) years from the date of empanelment.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declaration issued by OEM.
